name: Classic Chicken Cacciatore (Braised)
method: braise (stovetop, bone-in thighs & drumsticks simmered in tomato-wine sauce)
ingredients_verbatim: 2 rosemary sprigs (about 15 cm/6 inch long), or 1 tsp dried rosemary
3 anchovy fillets (or 1 tsp anchovy paste), optional
2 red capsicum (red bell pepper), sliced 8 mm thick
3/4 cup pinot noir or other dry red wine
unmapped: anchovy fillets (optional garnish/umami; can be omitted)
why: Verified published nutrition 495 cal / 37 g protein / 15 g carb per serving (6 servings) sits squarely in the band middle. True braise (bone-in thighs + drumsticks simmered in tomato-wine sauce, no pasta/rice in the dish), high-protein, structurally low-carb (meat + non-starchy veg + tomato). Distinct from the existing slow-cooker-chicken-cacciatore-PASTA (that one is pasta-based; this is the classic braise). Nearly all mains map to the Omaha board (red-wine and kalamata-olives both have homes); only the optional anchovy is unmapped. Batch-scales cleanly to 14 in a braising pot with weigh-and-divide.
confidence: high - nutrition read directly from source recipe card
